title: Inc. 5000 Conference & Gala (Omni Dallas) — Eric Ries speaks to America's fastest-growing private companies
summary: Eric speaks on Thursday October 15 at the 2026 Inc. 5000 Conference & Gala, Omni Dallas Hotel (the conference runs Oct 14–16). His session, 'The Uncertainty Advantage: How Leaders Navigate Risk and Seize Opportunity', is at 11:15am CT in Dallas Ballroom E alongside Janet Napolitano, moderated by Inc.'s Melissa Angell. Inc.'s speaker page lists him as 'Bestselling author and founder, Long-Term Stock Exchange.' The conference culminates in the black-tie gala with the Inc. 5000 roll call.
blockquote: The most prestigious event in entrepreneurship is back live – join us for the largest celebration of Inc. 5000 honorees ever.
